items.description: One synth-patch asset row — a whole puck.synth.v1 document embedded inline-canonical with its identity hash pinned beside it via SynthPatchCanonicalizer, the same pin/restart contract as WorldCreation; see WorldTune for the shared pin/restart semantics.

id.description: The row's stable string id — its mutation address; referenced by Synth and by PatchId facets.

document.description: The canonical (validated + normalized) synth patch document.

hash.description: The SHA-256 hex64 of the document's canonical bytes.
